Add your own mango farm / orchard photos here.

HERO & PAGE BACKGROUNDS (1920x1080 min):
  hero.jpg     – Main homepage hero (mango orchard wide shot)
  about.jpg    – About page hero (farm landscape)
  gallery.jpg  – Gallery hero (tree canopy / orchard rows)
  trees.jpg    – Our Trees hero (grove of mango trees)
  contact.jpg  – Contact hero (peaceful farm scene)
  booking.jpg  – Booking hero (fresh mangoes / harvest)

GALLERY GRID PHOTOS (800x600 min) — place in the gallery/ subfolder:
  gallery/01-harvest.jpg
  gallery/02-orchard.jpg
  gallery/03-mangoes.jpg
  gallery/04-leaves.jpg
  gallery/05-picking.jpg

After adding your photos:
  1. Open src/config/images.js
  2. Set  USE_LOCAL_PHOTOS = true
  3. Restart the dev server (npm run dev)
